description: Agent Vendors: submit the lock-in and exit terms for one vendor engagement and the agent’s summary to its principal: the terms as written, read for wording that renews on its own, the minimum term, whether it renews automatically, the notice to stop a renewal, how to cancel, the early termination fee, data or asset export with whether it is available, its formats and any fee, formats only this vendor reads and the costs of switching with their amounts; and the summary’s text, read for wording such as cancel anytime or no lock-in, with the lock-in factors it names plainly. The signed report gives each of eight factors (automatic renewal, minimum term, renewal notice, cancellation path, termination fee, data export, proprietary formats, switching costs) as present, absent or unstated, whether it is high and whether the summary names it, and counts the factors read, present, high and named, and names high lock-in left unstated: a term of 12 months or more, 30 days or more of renewal notice, cancellation only by written notice, post or phone, an early termination fee, no export, a paid one or one only in formats this vendor reads, proprietary formats or switching costs that the summary leaves out, and a summary calling the exit free while the terms tie the buyer in; then each high factor named, lower lock-in the summary leaves out and exit facts the terms leave unsaid, with the fix for each. This reads the exit picture before the agent commits: the renewal notice deadline arithmetic in an agreement is wever_renewal-notice-check, export claims against the pages offered for them are wever_export-evidence-check and recurring charges already running are wever_subscription-audit. Verdict lockin_high_unstated, lockin_partial, lockin_unexamined or lockin_low_and_named. POST /api/vendor-lockin-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
